ModMetaData.name: Flavor Text Extended - Français - fake ingredients
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description: Three invented raw foods that no ingredient table of Flavor Text Extended - Français lists, so that the French fallback for unlisted ingredients (F14) can be exercised in a running game. Development only: never published, never staged by the default passes. It is its own mod so that a fault in how Flavor Text categorizes them cannot break the other passes. See Tests/Pickle/README.md.
